title: SectionSupportedProExchangeIso
statement: For a chosen Cartesian square of closed immersions s and s-prime, the actual pro-etale supported-constant exchange is invertible for every finite commutative coefficient ring A. Use the maps of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps], with arbitrary base change.

proof.text: Apply the underived etale open/closed short exact sequence to the constant A-module. Constant restriction is its epic second map followed by direct image of the constant-unit isomorphism, so it is epic. Both etale pullback and site comparison preserve this epimorphism. This applies to arbitrary closed immersions, including empty source, without a quasi-compactness condition on the complementary open.

Use exchange_normalized, gamma_normalized and compare_constant_square from SupportedConstantExchangeNormalization, which are already proved for arbitrary commutative A. Precompose the desired comparison square with comparison applied to etale pullback of constant restriction. Naturality of comparePullback moves restriction across the comparison. The normalization identities reduce both sides to the coherent scalar units, and epic cancellation gives comparison(exchange_et) followed by gamma_s_prime equal to comparePullback followed by pro-pullback(gamma_s) followed by exchange_pro. This repeats the closed-map part of comparison_square without requiring its special PurityFiniteSetting coefficient ring.

The chosen Cartesian square gives IsPullback. Since a closed immersion is finite, the etale finite-exchange theorem and direct image of the constant-unit isomorphism make exchange_et invertible. The closed supported-comparison theorem makes gamma_s and gamma_s_prime invertible. Thus the left side of the comparison square is invertible, as are the first two factors on its right. Cancel those two factors using IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left to conclude that the specified exchange_pro is invertible.
